title: Nine Pounds in a Blue Book
subtitle: 数量与计量 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数量与计量（科学与技术·数量与计量）
meta: 主题语境：数量与计量（科学与技术·数量与计量）　|　核心词汇：amount　|　正文 319 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 amount 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 my grandmother kept a blue book in which every ① amount was written twice, once in pencil and once in ink, and the two never agreed. She said an amount is the only thing in a house that can be right and wrong at the same time, and my grandfather said that was not a fault in the book. He had ② an amount of nine pounds put by in 1954, and it took him six years and it was the whole of what he had.

The  amount of flour in the shop, which she weighed every Thursday for thirty-one years, went down by a fifth between 1968 and 1971 and nobody said why. There was ③ a large amount of talk about the price and none about the flour, and she said talk is the only thing in the world that is measured by how little it weighs.

In 1974 she wrote the same ④ amount twice on one page and left both standing, and when I asked her which was true she said the page was. The ⑤ amount owed to the shop by 1979 was nine hundred and forty-one pounds, which ⑥ amounted to more than the shop, and my father said a debt that amounts to more than the thing it is about is not a debt at all but a decision.

My uncle said the ⑦ amount of the whole thing, meaning the thirty-one years and not the money, was the only thing worth counting, and he had counted nothing in his life. Every ⑧ amount in the blue book after 1981 was in pencil only, and she said ink is for things you are willing to be wrong about in public.
The  amount I would write down, if I had the book, is not nine hundred and forty-one pounds but the nine pounds put by in six years, which is the only amount in it that anybody ever loved.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: E. 固定搭配：an amount of ... 一笔／一定数量的……
F. 固定搭配：a large / small amount of ... 大量／少量的……
G. 固定搭配：amount to ... 总计；等于；意味着（动词）
H. 固定搭配：the amount owed 欠款额；应付金额

items.q: an amount of nine pounds put by
a large amount of talk about the price
the same amount twice on one page
The amount owed to the shop
amounted to more than the shop
the amount of the whole thing
Every amount in the blue book

answers.why: amount 意为“数量、数额”，蓝皮本上每一个数额都写了两遍，一遍铅笔一遍墨水，而两遍从不一致。
an amount of ... 意为“一笔、一定数量的……”，1954 年他攒下了九英镑的一笔钱，攒了六年。
a large amount of ... 意为“大量的……”，关于价格有大量议论，关于面粉却一句也没有。
amount 意为“金额、款项”，1974 年她在同一页上把同一个金额写了两遍，两遍都留着。
the amount owed 意为“欠款额”，到 1979 年铺子的欠款额是九百四十一英镑。
amount to 意为“总计、等于”，那笔欠款算下来比铺子本身还多。
amount 意为“分量、程度”，叔叔说整件事的分量——指那三十一年而不是钱——才是唯一值得计算的。
amount 意为“总额”，1981 年以后蓝皮本上每一个数额都只用铅笔写。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 蓝皮本上每一个数额都写了两遍，一遍用铅笔，一遍用墨水，而两遍从不一致。（amount）
1954 年他攒下了一笔九英镑的钱，攒了六年。（an amount of）
铺子里面粉的数量在 1968 到 1971 年间少了五分之一，没人说原因。（the amount of）
关于价格有大量议论，关于面粉却一句也没有。（a large amount of）
到 1979 年铺子的欠款额是九百四十一英镑，比铺子本身还多。（the amount owed）
父亲说，一笔数额大到超过它所指之物的欠款，已经不是欠款，而是一个决定。（amount to）
answers: In the blue book every amount was written twice, once in pencil and once in ink, and the two never agreed.
He had an amount of nine pounds put by in 1954, and it took him six years.
The amount of flour in the shop went down by a fifth between 1968 and 1971.
There was a large amount of talk about the price and none about the flour.
The amount owed to the shop by 1979 was nine hundred and forty-one pounds.
My father said a debt that amounts to more than the thing it is about is not a debt but a decision.
